solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sacred texts incorporated in some brave statements

indicators.note: incorporated in some says the answer is a run of letters sitting inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone's bold declarations are said to borrow from scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put 'incorporated' in the definition; it belongs with 'in some' as the signal that the answer is tucked inside 'brave statements', leaving 'Sacred texts' as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Avesta is the collection of scriptures of Zoroastrianism, so it is a body of holy writings.

clue.text: Woman, one of a number in the orchestra?

definitions.meaning: a female first name, as with the heroine of Twelfth Night

definitions.text: one of a number in the orchestra?
definitions.meaning: a string instrument, several of which play in an orchestra's section

explanation.surface: A woman is singled out as one player among many in an orchestra.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a girl's name and the alto member of the violin family found in orchestras.

clue.text: Leader of society, inclined to be stiff

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, so this takes the opening letter of society

parts.note: something inclined is tilted, leaning at an angle

explanation.surface: A society bigwig is described as tending towards stiffness.
explanation.definitionFit: Stilted speech or manner is stiff and unnatural, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Star showing effrontery, female being put off

indicators.note: being put off says the female's letter is sent away from the word for effrontery

parts.note: to have the face to do something is to have cheek or effrontery

explanation.surface: A celebrity displays cheek, and a woman is deterred by it.
explanation.definitionFit: An ace is an expert or top performer, a star in some field.

clue.text: W. Churchill's successor curtailed part of farmer's livelihood

indicators.note: curtailed means having the tail, the last letter, cut off

parts.note: Clement Attlee followed Winston Churchill as Prime Minister in 1945; written with initial to match W. Churchill, that is C. Attlee

explanation.surface: A political history note about who followed Churchill, oddly tied to farming.
explanation.walkthrough: The initial matters: 'W. Churchill' prompts the same form for his successor, C. ATTLEE, whose final E is then cut.
explanation.definitionFit: Livestock such as cows make up a large part of what a farmer earns a living from.

clue.text: Sportsman? Chirpy type meeting Her Majesty

parts.note: a cricket is an insect known for its chirping
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword shorthand for the Queen

explanation.surface: A cheerful sportsman gets to meet the Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chirpy type' looks like a cheery person but is the insect. ER = Queen (Elizabeth Regina). Cricket is a bat-and-ball game hugely popular in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricketer is an example of a sportsman, which the question mark flags as a definition by example.

clue.text: Short piece of poetry given new introduction

indicators.note: a new introduction means the word's first letter is swapped for a different one

parts.note: a verse is a stanza or piece of poetry

explanation.surface: A brief poem is given a fresh opening.
explanation.walkthrough: The new first letter is not clued: VERSE with V changed to T gives a real word meaning short.
explanation.definitionFit: Terse means brief and to the point, a synonym of short in manner.

clue.text: Bird in middle of night having fun

parts.note: a lark is a songbird

indicators.note: middle of takes the central letter of the five-letter word night

explanation.surface: A bird out in the dead of night enjoying itself.
explanation.definitionFit: To lark about is to play pranks and fool around, so larking is having fun.

clue.text: One may have lots of books on the go

definitions.text: One may have lots of books on the go

parts.words: One may have lots of books on the go
parts.note: on the go suggests a busy reader, but here it means a lending service travelling in a van

explanation.surface: A busy reader with several books under way at once.
explanation.definitionFit: A van fitted out with shelves of lending stock that tours villages, literally carrying books while moving.

clue.text: Silly daughter getting behind

parts.note: aft means at or towards the back, as on a ship

explanation.surface: A foolish daughter is falling behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Daft is an informal British word for foolish or silly.

clue.text: The French king by spooky expanse of water

parts.note: la is a French word for the
K is the chess abbreviation for king
eerie means strange and frightening, spooky

explanation.surface: A French monarch stands beside a haunted stretch of water.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the Great Lakes of North America, a large body of fresh water.

clue.text: Girl keeping dull church observances towards the end

indicators.note: keeping means holding something within, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: lass is a word for a girl
trite means hackneyed, stale and dull

explanation.surface: A girl attends boring church services near the close of something.
explanation.definitionFit: The sacraments given to a dying person are religious rites performed near the end of life.

clue.text: Black suit essential when gardening

definitions.meaning: one of the two black suits in a pack of playing cards
digging tools, needed by anyone working in a garden

explanation.surface: Dark clothing is advised for working in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the card suit marked with black leaf shapes and the tools used for digging soil.

clue.text: Archbishop is formal at start of evensong

parts.note: prim means stiffly proper and formal

indicators.note: start of takes the first letter of evensong

explanation.surface: A senior cleric is very proper at the beginning of evening worship.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Church of England a primate is the archbishop of a province, such as Canterbury.

clue.text: Nevertheless, idea is incomplete

indicators.note: incomplete means the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: a thought is an idea

explanation.surface: A grudging remark that an idea is still unfinished.
explanation.definitionFit: As a sentence adverb, used at the end of a clause, it means however or all the same.

clue.text: Strange reason for eating good fruit

indicators.note: eating means taking something inside, so the good letter goes within the jumbled word
strange suggests something odd, so the letters of reason are made into an odd arrangement

explanation.surface: An odd excuse given for eating good fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' turns REASON into ORANES, and 'eating' puts G inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Oranges are citrus fruit, so they are examples of fruit.

clue.text: One hesitating to upset the rider

indicators.note: upset means knocked over or disturbed, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A dithering horseman is about to be thrown.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who dithers is indecisive and wavers, so a hesitating person.

clue.text: Person creating a stink with article

parts.note: hum is British slang for a bad smell
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone is kicking up a fuss over a newspaper piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Creating a stink' suggests making a fuss; here 'a stink' is HUM, British slang for a bad smell.
explanation.definitionFit: A human is a person, a member of humankind.

clue.text: Host and little woman outside front of restaurant

indicators.note: outside means the name goes around the other piece

parts.note: Amy March is one of the four sisters in Little Women

indicators.note: front of takes the first letter of restaurant

explanation.surface: A host and his wife wait outside the restaurant entrance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Host' looks like a restaurant host but means a multitude; 'little woman' is Amy from the novel Little Women.
explanation.definitionFit: A host is a great number, especially of soldiers, as in the heavenly host.

clue.text: This person, family member, produces a tiny bit of physics

parts.note: the setter speaking of themself, me
a son is a member of the family

explanation.surface: A parent and child together come up with a small physics discovery.
explanation.definitionFit: A meson is a subatomic particle, a minute thing studied in particle physics.

clue.text: When bad, go to this male, a blood expert

indicators.note: bad suggests something gone wrong, so these letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: If you feel unwell, see this man, a specialist in blood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When bad' reads as being ill, but 'bad' is the anagram signal for GO TO THIS MALE plus A.
explanation.definitionFit: This medical specialist studies and treats disorders of the blood.

clue.text: Story to be stretched out

definitions.meaning: a story in the sense of a fib or untruth
to recline flat, as on a bed

explanation.surface: A tale that gets drawn out.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a falsehood and to rest in a horizontal position.

clue.text: Time to go to Irish county town for a game

parts.note: Ennis is the county town of County Clare in Ireland

explanation.surface: Time to head to an Irish town for a match.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennis is a racket sport, an example of a game.

clue.text: From German city, European ascetic type

parts.note: Essen is a city in the Ruhr region of Germany

explanation.surface: A self-denying European hails from a German city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Essenes were a Jewish sect of ancient times who lived austere, ascetic lives.
